summary.text: Sean Parr is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 17, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a member of the Manchester Board of School Committee, representing Ward 2, an office he assumed on January 4, 2022.

paragraphs.text: Parr first won the Ward 2 seat on the Manchester Board of School Committee on November 2, 2021, defeating incumbent Kathleen Kelley Arnold.
He was re-elected as the incumbent on November 7, 2023, defeating Constance Spencer, and again on November 4, 2025, defeating Melodye Smith.
In 2024 he ran in the Democratic primary for New Hampshire State Senate District 20, which Patrick Long won.
